title: Z-RNA and the flipside of the SARS Nsp13 helicase
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SARS Nsp13解旋酶调控Z-RNA依赖的细胞死亡通路，核心为RNA-蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: We present evidence that the severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus (SARS) non-structural protein 13 (Nsp13) modulates the Z-RNA dependent regulated cell death pathways [1]. We show that Z-prone sequences (called flipons [2]) exist in coronavirus and provide a signature (Z-sig) that enables identification of the animal viruses from which the human pathogens arose. We also identify a potential RIP Homology Interaction Motif (RHIM) in the helicase Nsp13 that resembles those present in proteins that initiate Z-RNA-dependent cell death through interactions with the Z-RNA sensor protein ZBP1. These two observations allow us to suggest a model in which Nsp13 down regulates Z-RNA activated innate immunity by two distinct mechanisms. The first involves a novel ATP-independent Z-flipon helicase (flipase) activity in Nsp13 that differs from that of canonical A-RNA helicases. This flipase prevents formation of Z-RNAs that would otherwise activate cell death pathways. The second mechanism likely inhibits the interactions between ZBP1 and the Receptor Interacting Proteins Kinases RIPK1 and RIPK3 by targeting their RHIM domains. Together the described Nsp13 RHIM and flipase activities have the potential to alter the host response to coronaviruses and impact the design of drugs targeting the Nsp13 protein. The Z-sig and RHIM domains may provide a way of identifying previously uncharacterized viruses that are potentially pathogenic for humans.
abstract_zh: 我们提供的证据表明，严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒（SARS）的非结构蛋白13（Nsp13）调节Z-RNA依赖的调控性细胞死亡途径[1]。我们展示了Z倾向序列（称为flipons [2]）存在于冠状病毒中，并提供了一种特征（Z-sig），能够识别人类病原体起源的动物病毒。我们还在解旋酶Nsp13中识别出一个潜在的RIP同源相互作用基序（RHIM），该基序类似于通过Z-RNA传感器蛋白ZBP1相互作用启动Z-RNA依赖性细胞死亡的蛋白质中的基序。这两项观察使我们提出一个模型，其中Nsp13通过两种不同机制下调Z-RNA激活的先天免疫。第一种涉及Nsp13中一种新颖的ATP非依赖性Z-flipon解旋酶（flipase）活性，该活性不同于典型的A-RNA解旋酶。这种flipase阻止了本会激活细胞死亡途径的Z-RNA形成。第二种机制可能通过靶向ZBP1与受体相互作用蛋白激酶RIPK1和RIPK3的RHIM结构域，抑制它们之间的相互作用。综上所述，所描述的Nsp13 RHIM和flipase活性有可能改变宿主对冠状病毒的反应，并影响针对Nsp13蛋白的药物设计。Z-sig和RHIM结构域可能提供一种识别先前未表征且对人类具有潜在致病性的病毒的方法。
